decisive_spans.text: Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots

response.rationale: Cauda equina syndrome is directly supported by the presence of urinary retention and nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots. While Plasma cell leukemia is supported by diffuse heterogeneous T1- and T2-weighted signal abnormalities within bone marrow and severe flaccid quadriparesis, the combination of urinary retention and specific nerve root findings points more strongly to Cauda equina syndrome.
